# Journal Paper Template

Use this template to create new journal paper entries. Copy this file and fill in the details.

## YAML Frontmatter

```yaml
---
title: "Your Paper Title Here"
authors:
  - Author One
  - Author Two
journal: "Journal Name"
year: 2026
volume: "12"
issue: "3"
pages: "123-145"
doi: "10.1234/journal.2026.123456"
keywords:
  - keyword 1
  - keyword 2
  - keyword 3
abstract: |
  Your abstract text here. This should be a concise summary of your research,
  including the problem, methodology, key results, and significance.
pdf: "path/to/paper.pdf"
code: "https://github.com/username/repo"
data: "https://doi.org/data-doi"
---
```

## Paper Content

### Overview

[Provide a brief overview of the paper]

### Key Contributions

1. **Contribution 1**: Description of the first key contribution
2. **Contribution 2**: Description of the second key contribution
3. **Contribution 3**: Description of the third key contribution

### Methodology

[Describe the methodology used in the research]

### Results

[Present the key results and findings]

### Discussion

[Discuss the implications and significance of the results]

### References

[Include references in the appropriate format]

---

## How to Use

1. Copy this template to `public/papers/journal/[paper-name].qmd`
2. Fill in the YAML frontmatter with your paper details
3. Add your paper content below
4. Place PDF in `public/papers/journal/pdfs/` if available
5. Link code and data repositories if available
6. Update the journal papers index to include your paper

## Metadata Fields

- **title**: Full paper title
- **authors**: List of all authors
- **journal**: Journal name (e.g., "Nature Machine Intelligence")
- **year**: Publication year
- **volume**: Volume number (if applicable)
- **issue**: Issue number (if applicable)
- **pages**: Page range
- **doi**: Digital Object Identifier
- **keywords**: List of relevant keywords
- **abstract**: Paper abstract
- **pdf**: Link to PDF file
- **code**: Link to code repository
- **data**: Link to data repository

## Example Entry

```yaml
---
title: "From Notes to Knowledge: Designing an AI Wiki Companion"
authors:
  - Research Team
  - AI Education Research
journal: "Journal of Learning Analytics"
year: 2027
volume: "8"
issue: "1"
pages: "45-78"
doi: "10.1234/jla.2027.123456"
keywords:
  - generative AI
  - knowledge construction
  - self-regulated learning
  - metacognitive scaffolding
abstract: |
  Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) has substantially reduced the effort
  required to produce summaries, explanations, structured notes, and other learning
  artefacts. This paper presents the design and evaluation of an AI Wiki Companion
  that positions GenAI as a metacognitive scaffold rather than a substitute.
pdf: "pdfs/ai-wiki-companion-journal-2027.pdf"
code: "https://github.com/melcshum/AIResearchTracker"
---
```
